body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move the target to a visible empty supported space within 2 units of its current space. It must have an unobstructed path to the destination; this movement does not trigger movement Reactions.

surges.html: An ordinary restraint is suppressed during this movement; it resumes if its source still reaches the destination.

rider.title: Space Thread
rider.html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.
